title: Minkowski, Hecke, Landau, Kneser, and Other Classical Mathematics Authors: Modern LaTeX Drafts
description:
General author cluster for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record holds working packets for authors that are not yet split into dedicated author records, including Kneser, Mikami, Kronecker/Kron, Picard, Klein-Fricke, and related classical mathematics, plus older routed copies for authors that now have standalone records.

Status at a glance. This is a staging and backstop/provenance shelf. Some packages are source-witnessed working drafts; others are update packets, provenance, OCR/source-witness aids, or repair materials. Readers should use package README/status files and the public GitHub mirror for current status and correction pathways.

Current routing note. Poincare and Frobenius now have preferred standalone records. Older Poincare and Frobenius files here remain provenance/backstop where present. Kneser_LVR_p0206_0219_DE_EN_20260612.zip remains the current Kneser source-witnessed continuation in this mixed shelf.

Quality note. These are working/source-witnessed drafts and repair packets, not certified critical editions. Readers should verify important formulas, diagrams, theorem statements, and notation against the included source witnesses.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
version: 2026-06-13 mixed shelf backstop after Poincare/Frobenius splits
